dataset.description: Evidence database, cross-modal terminology mapping, and rubric benchmark for the HealthLens eight-axis integrated steady-state framework (A-H). Includes: (1) case evidence database with per-entry DOI verification status (14 verified out of 120, honestly reported; 91 entries are synthetic validation fixtures), (2) four-way terminology mapping (GB/T 20348-2026 <-> eight axes <-> Western pathways <-> classical texts), (3) classical Chinese medicine text fragments with axis annotations (613 entries, all marked needs_expert_review=true), (4) rubric benchmark for LLM-judge and human-expert alignment (60 entries), (5) eight-axis threshold configuration (externalized). All upstream bibliographic fields have been audited via three independent fail-loud defenses against leakage. Evidence coverage rate 11.7% (14/120 verified_crossref) is honestly reported; S1-1 95% target not achievable under current mixed schema.
